== Verbatim dest (R-2026-10-23-a) ==
* Verbatim dest of Michael Mikaelian and George Strayton, "The Sith Element", ''InQuest'' #43 (November 1998), pp. 52–54 and 56–57, corrected against opened jp2 page scans [[File:InQuest 43 page 52.jpg]]–[[File:InQuest 43 page 54.jpg]] and [[File:InQuest 43 page 56.jpg]]–[[File:InQuest 43 page 57.jpg]] from archive.org/details/IQ.Gamer.Partial.Collection (inquest.043.(1998-11)_jp2.zip). Printed page 55 is an Auction Universe ad and was not dested.
* Fake ''Lords of the Sith'' cards left unlinked. Printed spellings kept (Yavin IV; Utinni effect; Batoal in the Bataal Bandu lore). Steve Stone credited in the lead and unlinked (no person page).
* Mockup game text on pp. 54 and 56 differs from the page 57 listings for Rise from the Grave (deploy on any system vs Korriban) and shorter Bataal Bandu lore on the mockup; dest follows each page as printed.
